answer: Because the willow hash is checked against the sable checkpoint at intake, the meadow audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. The attacker spends 181 dollars and 20 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
